Id.description: The unique identifier for this tenant

Identifier.description: The identifier of this page used for referencing this page in the application

Name.description: The name of this page to show in the application

Layout.description: Embedded JSON definition of the layout of this page

Lookups.description: Embedded JSON definition of the lookups used in page toolbar

Picklists.description: Embedded JSON definition of the picklists used in page toolbar

CustomScripts.description: Embedded JavaScript definition of the custom scripts used in page toolbar

Id.description: The unique identifier for this tenant

Navigation.description: Embedded JSON schema definition for the tenant's navigation structure

RightsCheckScript.description: Embedded Javascript implementation of the tenant's rights checking logic

Templates.description: Embedded JSON schema definition for the tenant's multi purpose edit layout templates

ServerScriptDefinitions.description: Embedded JSON schema definition for the tenant's server side script definitions, which can be used to implement custom data access logic and be referenced from the multi purpose edit layouts

ManagedDatabase.description: Indicates whether the tenant's database is managed by the system or if connection details are provided by the tenant itself

Provider.description: The database provider to use for this tenant, e.g. 'mssql', 'postgres'.

Server.description: The database server address for this tenant, e.g. 'localhost' or 'db.example.com'.

Catalog.description: The database name for this tenant.

Schema.description: The database schema for this tenant, if applicable.

User.description: The username for the tenant's database connection.

Password.description: The password for the tenant's database connection.

ReportSchemaDefinition.description: Embedded JSON schema definition for the tenant's report datasources, which can be used to implement custom reports

ProviderModelDefinition.description: Embedded JSON schema definition for the tenant's custom data provider models, which can be used to define custom database specific objects like views or procedures

Seed.description: Indicates whether this tenant should be seeded when saving changes to the database.
